description: This file defines a Monitor class responsible for tracking and managing metrics related to user sessions in a CRM system. It includes methods for setting and retrieving metric values, handling storage, and session management, and interacts with external Metric and Store classes.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A class for monitoring user activity metrics, managing metric values, and interacting with storage mechanisms within the CRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Monitor instance by loading metadata from a PHP file and setting up metrics based on the provided dictionary.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified metric if it is mutable, marking the monitor as dirty for later saving.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified metric.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Returns the list of storage mechanisms associated with this monitor.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Returns the array of Metric instances associated with this monitor.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the monitor has unsaved changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the monitor's data to storage if it is enabled and marked as dirty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all mutable metric values and marks the monitor as not dirty.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Returns a Store instance for a given store name, loading and instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current PHP session ID, MD5-hashed if it exceeds a maximum length.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the monitor's current metrics and their values as an associative array.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the monitor's ability to save data.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is enabled.
